'''Cadrath''' was a [[TIE pilot]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was stationed on a [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] shortly before [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] and was assigned as the first [[Wingmate/Legends|wingmate]] of rookie [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]], teaching Stele how to properly check his [[Flight suit/Legends|flight suit]] prior to launch. While conducting a patrol, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] pilots came across a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] running weapons for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. A [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of Rebel [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] moved to engage the Imperials, but Cadrath and Stele helped to defeat the Rebels.<ref name="Stele Chronicles" />
